methodology: three alternating rounds, fresh 1M-row fixtures, identical probe source; stage instrumentation enabled; eleven samples after three warmups; independent results and full scrubs; not network throughput

cases.name: unordered_filter
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(value) FROM events WHERE value >= 0

cases.name: sparse_filter
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(value), AVG(value), MIN(value), MAX(value) FROM events WHERE device = 7

cases.name: multi_filter
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(value), SUM(device) FROM events WHERE ts >= 200317 AND ts < 700123 AND value >= 0 AND device <> 7

cases.name: grouped
cases.sql: SELECT device, COUNT(*), SUM(value), MIN(value), MAX(value) FROM events GROUP BY device ORDER BY device

cases.name: filtered_group
cases.sql: SELECT device, COUNT(*), SUM(value) FROM events WHERE value >= 0 GROUP BY device ORDER BY device

cases.methodology: opt-in per-block timings; baseline row loop combines selection and aggregation; stage times exclude planning/index operations; three warmups and eleven samples; full scrub outside timings
